newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices steady on easing arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices steady on easing arrivals.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices were steady on Thursday at improved levels, dealers said.

"Volumes remained low but sentiments were firm on reports of sliding arrivals in producing centres as well as export demand," one dealer said. Export deals for Indian castor oil fetched $705 per tonne for ready delivery and $680 dollars on forwards.
Groundnut oil was steady at 441-442 rupees per 10 kg on less inflows. Rajkot spot oil was steady at 710/715 rupees per 15 kg.
